attributes.class: =if(@currentField == 'New', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'Triage', 'sp-field-severity--warning', if(@currentField == 'Accepted', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'In progress', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'Blocked', 'sp-field-severity--blocked', if(@currentField == 'Done', 'sp-field-severity--good', if(@currentField == 'Declined', 'sp-field-severity--severeWarning', '')))))))

attributes.iconName: =if(@currentField == 'New', 'CircleRing', if(@currentField == 'Triage', 'Filter', if(@currentField == 'Accepted', 'Accept', if(@currentField == 'In progress', 'Forward', if(@currentField == 'Blocked', 'Blocked', if(@currentField == 'Done', 'CheckMark', if(@currentField == 'Declined', 'Cancel', '')))))))
